faqDescription: Quick answers about how Rallly works, pricing, and privacy.
faqDoodleDifference: How is Rallly different from Doodle?
faqDoodleDifferenceAnswer: Rallly gives you professional, ad-free meeting polls in a clean and easy to use interface. Participants can vote without creating an account, and if you want full control of your data you can even host Rallly on your own server.
faqIsFreeAnswer: Yes. 99% of people use Rallly completely free. Creating polls, sharing them, and collecting votes costs nothing and there is no limit on participants. We also offer <0>Rallly Pro</0>, a paid subscription with features that are useful if you use Rallly professionally, like adding your own branding, removing Rallly attribution from your polls, and keeping polls around indefinitely.
faqNeedAccount: Do I need an account to use Rallly?
faqNeedAccountAnswer: No. You can create a poll and vote on one without signing up. Creating a free account lets you manage your polls from any device and get notified when people respond.
faqNonprofit: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
faqNonprofitAnswer: Yes. We offer discounted Rallly Pro subscriptions for registered nonprofits. Email us at <0>support@rallly.co</0> and we will get you set up.
faqPrivacyAnswer: Yes. Privacy is central to how we build Rallly. We do not show ads or sell your data, we collect only what we need to run the service, and polls on the free plan are deleted automatically once they become inactive. Rallly is also open source, so anyone can inspect how their data is handled. You can read the details in our <0>privacy policy</0>.
faqSelfHostAnswer: Yes. Rallly is open source and can be deployed on your own infrastructure with Docker. Check the <0>self-hosting docs</0> to get started.
faqTeams: How does Rallly work for teams?
faqTeamsAnswer: You can invite your team into a shared space where everyone creates and manages polls together. Billing is centralized. A single subscription covers the whole team, and you can add or remove seats as your team changes.
faqTimeZones: Does Rallly work across time zones?
faqTimeZonesAnswer: Yes. When you create a poll with specific times, each participant sees the options in their own time zone automatically, so nobody has to do the math.
faqWhatIsRalllyAnswer: Rallly is a meeting scheduling tool. You create a poll with a few proposed times, share a link, and participants vote on the times that work for them. When the votes are in, you can see at a glance which time suits everyone best.
faqWhen2meetDifference: How is Rallly different from When2meet?
faqWhen2meetDifferenceAnswer: When2meet asks everyone to paint their availability on a grid, which can be fiddly, especially on a phone. Rallly keeps it simple: you suggest times, participants vote with a tap, and you get notified as responses come in. Participants can leave comments, and when the votes are in you can confirm a final time so everyone knows what was decided.
faqWhen2meetFreeAnswer: Yes, When2meet is free, and if all you need is a quick availability grid it works fine. Rallly is also free, without the ads, and adds the parts When2meet leaves out: an interface that works well on mobile, email notifications when people respond, comments, and a dashboard to manage all your polls.
faqWhen2meetMobile: Does Rallly work well on mobile?
faqWhen2meetMobileAnswer: Yes. Voting on a Rallly poll is a matter of tapping the times that work for you, so it feels natural on a phone. There is no drag-select grid to wrestle with on a small screen.
